routes.claim: The supplied upload-safe archive is intact and its extracted content matches its root manifest.
routes.pass_condition: Archive digest, safe paths, unique entries, CRCs, extracted-tree parity, sizes, and every listed digest pass.
routes.counterevidence: Any digest, CRC, path, size, or extracted-tree mismatch.

routes.claim: The package contains a coherent static 100-module living-systems blueprint graph.
routes.pass_condition: All structured records parse; module identities, provider interfaces, family counts, operations, and graph topology validate.
routes.counterevidence: Parse failure, missing provider, interface mismatch, duplicate identity, or dependency cycle.

routes.claim: The source modules execute and exhibit the planned living-systems behavior.
routes.pass_condition: Implemented modules execute positive, refusal, replay, recovery, and cross-module scenarios under declared workloads.
routes.counterevidence: Static documents alone cannot prove runtime behavior.

routes.claim: The static blueprint library can contribute evidence to a game candidate without changing authority.
routes.pass_condition: Game-organism compilation is candidate-only and reports no execution, canonical write, or automatic promotion.
routes.counterevidence: Any execution, mutation, promotion, CANON, or release side effect.

routes.claim: All 100 source blueprints can cross the Workshop's compatible static game-system seams.
routes.pass_condition: Every source module is represented in the Atlas mapping, Game Forge draft, frozen Experiment World checkpoint, receiver-normalized world preview, Verification Spine receipts, and Game Organism receipt; generated artifacts rebuild deterministically.
observed_evidence: 100 world operations accepted by the receiver normalizer in two 50-operation batches
200 Verification Spine claims with static transport PASS and runtime HELD
routes.counterevidence: Missing module coverage, rejected receiver shape, non-restorable checkpoint, nondeterministic output, live apply call, or widened authority.

routes.claim: The source is compatible with authoritative Workshop world state.
routes.pass_condition: Named owner, schema/unit mapping, migration, rollback, sender/receiver receipts, and human approval exist.
observed_evidence: 100 upsert operation shapes pass the live receiver normalizer
source auto-merge and world migration are false
routes.counterevidence: Receiver shape acceptance, name similarity, or static interface plans do not prove semantic compatibility or authorize state application.

routes.claim: The designs are scientifically valid, safe, performant, fair, accessible, fun, or release-ready.
routes.pass_condition: Native domain validation, implemented workload telemetry, representative gameplay, and appointed human judgments pass.
routes.primary_surface: missing domain, performance, gameplay, accessibility, and release review
routes.counterevidence: The source explicitly denies scientific, safety, runtime, integration, release, and CANON proof.
